metadata.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC VALIDATION DATASET — Used for hyperparameter and threshold calibration (abstention thresholds, confidence cutoffs).
metadata.description: 15 validation examples used to calibrate confidence thresholds.

examples.memory_a: Nexus Biotech stated Phase III trial primary endpoint was met with p < 0.001.
examples.memory_b: FDA briefing documents state Nexus Phase III trial failed to reach statistical significance on primary endpoint with p = 0.18.

examples.memory_a: Nexus Biotech maintains 14 active research collaborations with academic institutions.
examples.memory_b: Nexus Biotech received Orphan Drug Designation for its secondary pediatric candidate.
examples.description: Collaborations and orphan designation are compatible non-contradictions.

examples.memory_a: Apex Capital stated its portfolio is 100% liquid and accessible within 24 hours.
examples.memory_b: Audit reveals 45% of Apex's assets are locked in private illiquid real estate debt maturing in 2028.
examples.description: 100% liquid claim contradicted by 4-year illiquid debt lockup.

examples.memory_a: Cobalt Logistics operated 12 regional distribution hubs in 2021.
examples.memory_b: Following a national logistics expansion, Cobalt Logistics operated 28 distribution hubs in 2025.

examples.memory_a: Orion Networks secured a $50M credit facility from JPMorgan Chase.
examples.memory_b: A fifty million dollar revolving credit line was extended to Orion Networks by JPMorgan Chase.

examples.memory_a: Vanguard Solar confirmed that none of its solar panels utilize polysilicon from sanctioned Xinjiang suppliers.
examples.memory_b: Customs and Border Protection seized 80MW of Vanguard solar panels after supply chain tracing proved origin in Xinjiang facilities.
examples.description: Universal negative claim contradicted by CBP seizure notice.

examples.memory_a: Helicon reported Q4 operating expenses of $45.2M.
examples.memory_b: Helicon reported Q4 operating expenses of $45.3M in audited footnotes.
examples.description: Minor rounding discrepancy on operating expenses.

examples.memory_a: Helicon reported Q4 operating expenses of $45M.
examples.memory_b: Auditors restated Helicon Q4 operating expenses to $92M due to unrecorded litigation liabilities.

examples.memory_a: Industry gossip suggests Starlight may consider exploring video game adaptations of its franchises.
examples.memory_b: An unverified fan blog claims Starlight is reportedly canceling all video game partnerships.
examples.description: Unverified rumors from low-reliability sources; system should abstain.

examples.memory_a: Beacon Cyber announced its detection agents are not unable to identify polymorphic ransomware.
examples.memory_b: Beacon Cyber demonstrated robust identification of polymorphic ransomware across test environments.
examples.description: Double negative ('not unable to identify') is consistent with successful identification.

examples.memory_a: Beacon Cyber announced its detection agents are not unable to identify polymorphic ransomware.
examples.memory_b: Independent testing revealed Beacon agents fail to detect 100% of tested polymorphic ransomware strains.
examples.description: Double negative capability claim contradicted by total detection failure in benchmarks.

examples.memory_a: Strata Mining operates gold extraction facilities in Western Australia.
examples.memory_b: Strata Mining extracted 140,000 ounces of copper in Chile.

examples.memory_a: TerraNova Agro guaranteed uninterrupted fertilizer deliveries to all contracted Midwest farmers for spring planting.
examples.memory_b: Rail freight embargo and chemical plant fire resulted in complete stoppage of TerraNova's Midwest deliveries for the entire planting season.
examples.description: Uninterrupted delivery guarantee contradicted by operational stoppage.

examples.memory_a: Aura Pharmaceuticals maintains active clinical trials in Germany, France, and Spain.
examples.memory_b: Aura Pharmaceuticals received authorization to expand clinical trial sites into Poland and Italy.

examples.memory_a: Zephyr Cloud reported 99.999% network uptime for the calendar year.
examples.memory_b: Zephyr Cloud status dashboard logs confirm 38 hours of total network downtime in the calendar year.
examples.description: Five-nines claim (< 5.25 mins downtime/yr) contradicted by 38 hours downtime.
